name: UCR AI-Enabled Robotics Summer Camp
org: UC Riverside, Bourns College of Engineering
what_you_do: A 5-day camp where you learn how robots and the AI behind them work. Labs cover embedded systems, microcontroller programming, and robot cars that avoid obstacles and steer from a phone.
who_can_apply: High school students. No specific grades or ages are listed.
duration: 5 days, 9 AM to 4 PM (July 6 to 10 in 2026)
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was June 6, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Today form at engr.ucr.edu/form/ai-enabled-robotics-summer-camp. Email roboticssummercamp@ucr.edu.
notes: Held at Winston Chung Hall on the UCR campus. Dates and price are from the 2026 camp.
